verdict.rationale: Persona's API covers core identity verification workflows—creating inquiries, verifications, reports, workflows, templates, and webhooks for events—suggesting broad programmatic parity with UI-driven flows. However, evidence emphasizes Hosted Flow (UI-redirect) as the 'fastest setup' path and doesn't explicitly confirm every dashboard configuration action (e.g., building workflows, editing templates/theming, account/user management) is achievable purely via API rather than the dashboard UI. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that dashboard-only config tasks (workflow builder, template editing, theming, org/user management) are fully API-accessible, and independent/hands-on confirmation of full UI/API parity.
